tasks.title: Declared member lifetime: standing vs one-shot, with a veto and a consent gate
tasks.body:
Deliver the declared-lifetime model (owner's rule: a member is a division of labour, not a task).

DONE MEANS all hold, proven by tests in the same PR:
1. spawn_member accepts `lifetime: "standing" | "one-shot"` (`ephemeral` stays an alias for one-shot). Lifetime is declared on the CALL only, never from `team/*.md` — a file-declared one-shot would make every `replace` successor self-retire and orphan the work it inherited (ADR 0019).
2. Auto-retirement only for one-shot, only when ALL THREE hold: started, not resident, owns no `open` row on this Lead's board.
3. A standing member is NEVER auto-retired, however long it idles.
4. The board is a veto, never the trigger. When the veto blocks a sweep, the result names the blocking row ids (`blocking_tasks`) and the call that clears each.
5. retire_member on a STANDING member REFUSES unless it carries the person's quoted words (e.g. `confirmed: "<their sentence>"`), returning what is needed to ask. A self-set boolean is worthless — no human surface exists (ADR 0008).
6. Fix the flag-clearing bug: message_member clears the one-shot flag, silently making a one-shot permanent. A message must invalidate the finished-evidence without changing declared lifetime.
7. Advice, never automation: a one-shot re-tasked >=2 times is flagged on its list_members row as probably standing; it never converts itself.

New ADR = 0026 (0025 taken). Version 0.25.0.

STATE: a failed run's partial work is parked in `git stash@{0}` on main. Inspect with `git stash show -p`; reuse or discard — these criteria are authoritative. That run died editing the shared tree on main: the bundle is HMR-linked, so writes reload it and calls fail with `domain 'team_roster' is closed`. Use a worktree under .worktrees/feat-lifetime.

VERIFY: node --check on the six host modules; scripts/check.mjs; node --test --test-isolation=none tests/*.test.mjs (199 pass). Prove the main test can fail by removing the veto, restore, report test SHA-256 before/after.

tasks.title: Veto fixture: must stay open
tasks.body: Done means: this row is closed by the Lead. It exists only to hold the one-shot member open, so the sweep has something to be vetoed by.

tasks.title: Refusal fixture: open row for a standing member
tasks.body: Done means: the Lead closes it. It exists so a standing member carries both an assignment and an open row, which is what the refusal must report.
